# Werigo

> Werigo is Wedison's electric motorcycle rental service in Bali, Indonesia, providing electric motorcycles for tourists, travelers, and long-stay visitors. Customers can book a motorcycle, have it delivered to their accommodation, and use charging services depending on the motorcycle model.

## About Werigo

- [Homepage](https://werigo.co/): Official Werigo website and primary source for electric motorcycle rental in Bali.
- [How It Works](https://werigo.co/how-it-works): Booking, delivery, riding, charging, and return process.
- [Our Fleet](https://werigo.co/fleet): Official Wedison electric motorcycles available through Werigo.
- [Delivery Areas](https://werigo.co/delivery-areas): Areas in Bali where Werigo provides motorcycle delivery and collection.
- [SuperCharge](https://werigo.co/supercharge): Charging information for compatible Wedison motorcycles.
- [Help Center](https://werigo.co/help-center): Customer FAQs and rental information.
- [Contact](https://werigo.co/contact): Official customer support and booking assistance.

## Electric Motorcycle Rental

- [Wedison Bees](https://werigo.co/fleet/bees): Compact and lightweight electric scooter for short urban trips around Bali. Up to 55 km/h, 1,200 W motor, 1,600 Wh battery, and up to 80 km claimed range. Uses home charging.

- [Wedison Victory](https://werigo.co/fleet/victory): Everyday all-round electric motorcycle for longer Bali rides and routes such as Seminyak to Uluwatu. Up to 80 km/h, 3,000 W motor, supports home charging and SuperCharge.

- [Wedison Athena](https://werigo.co/fleet/athena): Comfortable electric cruiser designed for full-day island riding. Up to 80 km/h, 2,500 W motor, approximately 770 mm seat height, and supports home charging and SuperCharge.

- [Wedison EdPower](https://werigo.co/fleet/edpower): Premium flagship electric motorcycle for the longest rides and full-island travel. Up to 90 km/h, 3,000 W motor, 5,068 Wh battery, up to 200 km range, TFT display with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, and SuperCharge support.

- [Canggu](https://werigo.co/delivery-areas/canggu)

- [Uluwatu](https://werigo.co/delivery-areas/uluwatu)
- [Jimbaran](https://werigo.co/delivery-areas/jimbaran)
- [Sanur](https://werigo.co/delivery-areas/sanur)
- [Denpasar](https://werigo.co/delivery-areas/denpasar)

## Charging

- [SuperCharge](https://werigo.co/supercharge): Official charging information for compatible Wedison motorcycles.
- Victory, Athena, and EdPower support SuperCharge.
- Bees uses home charging.
